avr.text: After being released from the Helvault, Avacyn cast the cursemute, offering repentant werewolves a place at her side and letting them fuse their human and wolf spirits into a permanent form, and the Gatstaf werewolves became the wolfir.
She decreed that the werewolves would become the wolfir, allies in combat against darkness, though Rorica broke with her order to lead a crusade against the reformed werewolves.
The transformation was mostly reversed when Avacyn was corrupted through Nahiri's machinations, and she abandoned humanity and the cursemute broke.
